messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: min/max stepper prototype in the mock. Main issues I want feedback on: keyboard increments, live cost toast when you nudge min down, and clarity around 'min includes burst' copy. Also mobile compacting. Jon: Saw the mock. Two quick things: the stepper increments by 0.5 in prototype but we only allow whole GPUs in infra. That confuses the cost calc. Can we lock step to 1 for the UI and surface fractional GPU equivalents elsewhere? Adele: Agree on whole numbers. Users expect to pick integer GPUs. If we show "0.5 equivalent" that feels magical. Better: step = 1; add a small secondary line: "Estimated concurrency per GPU: 2x (for reference)". Marco: On the live cost toast: current mock pops a transient toast at top-right when min changes showing "New estimated cost: $123 / mo". Two problems: 1) toast covers the header in narrow screens, 2) it disappears too fast and isn't readable for low-vision users. Priya: Good catch. We should avoid obscuring nav. Options: anchor the cost summary inline under the stepper (non-modal), or show a sticky bottom sheet on mobile. Also adjust toast duration and provide an expand button to pin it. Jon: From accessibility POV: make toast keyboard-focusable and include a close button. Add aria-live for updates so screen readers hear new estimate. Example snippet: ```
New estimate: $123 / mo
``` Adele: Copy nit: "Min includes burst" is ambiguous. Users asked in research whether burst is reserved capacity or temporary. Propose two lines: small label under min: "Min (guaranteed capacity)" and an info tooltip: "Burst allows short-lived extra GPUs subject to availability." Marco: UX interactions: when users hold ArrowUp to rapidly increase min, the cost calc fires many requests and spikes backend. We should debounce and show an interim indicator: "Updating estimate..." then final number. Also keyboard long-press should respect rate limits. Priya: Agree. Debounce 400ms and cancel inflight if new change. Also add client-side estimate model to give instant approximate cost while server calculates exact. That reduces perceived lag. ux-bot: Heuristic suggestions: (1) keyboard step 1, shift+arrow to step 5, (2) hold to accelerate: 1,1,2,3,5 sequence, (3) debounce cost requests 400ms, (4) ensure cost element has contrast >=4.5:1. Jon: Accessibility checks: stepper should be a spinner control with role=spinbutton and include aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and aria-valuetext for formatted string. Example: ``` ``` Adele: Visual focus: current mock hides native outline for stepper and uses a thin custom ring. Need thicker 3px ring and ensure high contrast. Also increase touch target for +/\u2013 buttons to 44px. Marco: Mobile layout: in portrait, the stepper, small copy, and SLO slider are stacking. The live cost pushing content causes layout jump. Let's reserve a 48px placeholder under the header so the cost area can expand without pushing things. That avoids reflow. Priya: On testing: let's do three quick prototypes: A) inline cost summary that replaces reserved placeholder, B) toast anchored to top-right with pin option, C) bottom sheet on mobile. We'll run 8 participants in moderated tests focusing on discoverability and comprehension of "min vs burst". Jon: I'll add ARIA attributes in the component and a small e2e test asserting aria-live announcement fired and spinbutton attrs present. Adele: I'll update Figma: integer-only stepper, improved focus ring, info tooltip copy, and a reserved placeholder box. Also include the shift+arrow affordance in microcopy: "Hold Shift for +5". Marco: I'll prototype client-side cost estimator that runs instantly (cheap math) and falls back to server estimate. Also add debounce and cancel logic. Priya: Final asks before Friday handoff: ensure cost copy uses monthly estimate label, add link to pricing docs in tooltip, and update mobile CSS for reserved placeholder. Also capture performance metrics: how many cost requests per minute during rapid changes. ux-bot: Planned audits: color contrast report, focus ring size check, touch target size check, aria roles validation. Priya: Thanks all. Let's reconvene Thursday after prototypes. :sparkles: Jon: Sounds good. Adele: +1 Marco: thumbsup:
